title: Query shapes
summary: The handful of SQL shapes that cover most analytical questions.

blocks.body: Almost every reporting query is one of three shapes: aggregate, join, or window.

items: Aggregate — collapse rows into a metric
Window — rank or trend without collapsing

blocks.code:
SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS trips
FROM trips
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY trips DESC;

blocks.text: Filter before you aggregate; aggregate before you join when row counts allow.

rows: Who is first in each group?
